_comment: Audit I-03 — FAQ content, rendered on service pages and marked up as FAQPage JSON-LD (A-05). Every answer below is grounded in what the project pages already document (phased work in occupied schools, shop drawings, as-builts, O&M documentation, commissioning, DDC integration with Delta/Reliable/Trane, seismic remediation). Entries carrying "confirm": true make a claim Allied has not yet verified in writing — they are NOT rendered until the flag is removed. See docs/audit/open-items.md (Q3, Q6).

general.q: Can you replace a boiler plant while the school is occupied?
general.a: Yes — most of our school work is done in occupied buildings. At Ridgeview Elementary we converted 12 classrooms to unit ventilators and installed a six-boiler plant around the school's operating requirements; at Garibaldi Highlands we replaced over 20 furnaces and built a new mechanical room. Phasing, after-hours work and shutdown windows are agreed before anything starts.

general.q: Do you provide O&M manuals and as-builts?
general.a: Yes. Shop drawings, as-built records and operation and maintenance documentation are part of our project scope, along with testing, balancing and commissioning coordination, so the building team can run what we installed.

general.q: Can you integrate with our existing DDC?
general.a: Yes. We regularly work with Delta, Reliable and Trane controls for integration, trending, alarms and commissioning. At École Glenayre the DDC upgrade ran alongside the boiler plant work.

general.q: Do you work to our engineer's specification?
general.a: Yes. We install to the consultant's drawings and specification, and coordinate submittals and engineering review through them. Tell us who the engineer is when you send the enquiry.

general.q: What does a preventive maintenance contract include?
general.a: Monthly, quarterly or annual visits with equipment checks, DDC reviews, trend analysis and a written report with recommendations. The visit frequency and the equipment list are set per building.

general.q: Do you service schools and strata?
general.a: Both. Our documented work covers school districts 40, 43, 45 and 48, Capilano University, ICBC and strata and apartment buildings such as 1755 Haro Street for Starlight Investments.

general.q: How quickly can you respond to an emergency?
general.a: Our line is answered 24/7 on 604-731-1000. Response timing depends on your location, the issue and technician availability — call rather than wait for a form reply.

general.q: Do you handle permits and Technical Safety BC inspections?
general._note: Q3 — confirm which permits Allied pulls directly and which licences it holds before publishing an answer.
